reviews.text:
5 Stars – Fantastic Care for Our Energetic Frenchie!
Our French Bulldog, Max, recently stayed at Ellie’s Dog Adventures and we couldn't be happier with the experience! Max is full of energy and can be a bit of a handful, but Ellie and her team handled him with such care, patience, and enthusiasm. They made sure he got plenty of playtime and attention!

We were especially impressed by how well they managed his medication. It's always nerve-wracking leaving your pet in someone else's care, but knowing Max's needs were met (and exceeded) gave us real peace of mind.

Max absolutely loves going there—he runs in with excitement every time we arrive! Thank you to Ellie and the whole team for treating him like one of your own. We’re so grateful to have found such a wonderful place for our boy.
Highly recommend!

We used Ellie following recommendation, and was extremely happy with the service. Beau was very happy to be around other like minded dogs, and had lots of fun every day. The instagram stories were great to see how he was getting on. Would definitely recommend and use again

Ellie’s Doggy Daycare has been wonderful for my small dog. The team are incredibly friendly and caring, and she has built a lot of confidence since starting there. She always seems excited to go in and clearly has a great time. They also offer boarding and looked after her brilliantly while I was away for a week. Highly recommended.

Ellie is absolutely amazing with dogs. I left my dog with her for daycare and my dog was the happiest i’ve seen him in a long time as she also looks after other dogs so little Alfie had someone to play with as well. So, I decided to leave my dog with her when I went on holiday and I have to say Ellie was absolutely amazing as usual. She provided regular updates through her Instagram Page which I loved to see. Would recommend Ellie to anybody who is looking for daycare for their dog and or even boarding if you are going on holiday.!
My dog was very happy spending the week with Ellie whilst I was away. This is the 3rd time we've used her services and would highly recommend 👍🏼 …
Trusted doggy day care! Carefully considers breeds and traits prior to accepting dogs, making it a pleasant experience for all dog owners when away for some time, plenty of outdoor space.
Absolutely great experience and I would not go to anyone else. These dogs are my life and I know they are getting the best of the best with Ellie!

Ellie and her mum provide a reliable, trustworthy and loving pet boarding service. My dog unfortunately got ill when she was staying at Ellie’s but they were super responsive and looked after my dog with great care and attention. Thank you so much!

Just picked my dog up after a 2 week stay with Ellie and Mary. The pre-drop off checks were very thorough and reassuring. They kept us up to date with photos, and my dog looked really happy. Huge weight off our minds that we have found a reliable and friendly dog boarder.
